design_parameters.enrich_notes: WQV sizing is referenced (75% WQV in bioretention, WQV orifice 4–8 in below organic soil in gravel wetland) but no explicit WQV rainfall depth in inches in excerpts. SHGT separation varies: 18 in (filter strip/pretreatment), 36 in (3 ft) for many infiltration/bioretention tops or reservoir bottoms. Design infiltration: half field-derived rate or RI Rules values; 0.52 in/hr explicit for loam surface layer; 0.5 in/hr minimum in-situ to use infiltration STUs; do not use infiltration STUs if >8.3 in/hr. Bioretention ponding 6–12 in (basins/planters); swale max WQV ponding 12 in at mid-point. Porous pavement reservoir minimum 4 in (increase as needed). Gravel wetland optional extended detention when inline—no drain time given.
